q: The Electric Loco Shed at Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Nagar (formerly Mughalsarai), which homes electric locomotives, functions under which zonal railway?
e: Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Nagar is a major junction of East Central Railway, so its Electric Loco Shed functions under that zone.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Guntakal, which homes diesel locomotives, functions under which zonal railway?
e: Guntakal is a division of South Central Railway, so its Diesel Loco Shed functions under South Central Railway.

q: The Zonal Railway Training Institute (ZRTI) at Bhuli, near Dhanbad, functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Zonal Railway Training Institute at Bhuli near Dhanbad is an Eastern Railway institute (listed as ZRTI/Bhuli/ER among the Railway Board's main training centres); its courses also serve East Central Railway staff, but it functions under Eastern Railway.

q: The headquarters (central) hospital of the East Central Railway is located at:
e: The headquarters hospital of East Central Railway is its Super Speciality Hospital at Patna, serving as the zone's central hospital.

q: In the working of trains on Indian Railways, the abbreviation 'WTT' stands for:
e: WTT is the timetable governing train working on a section, and it stands for Working Time Table.

q: In Indian Railways, the computer application 'COA', used by train controllers for online charting and monitoring of train movements, stands for:
e: COA is the application used in control offices for online train charting, and it stands for Control Office Application.

q: In the Railway Board's office, the abbreviation 'RBSS', denoting the secretariat service whose officers handle the secretariat work of the Board, stands for:
e: RBSS stands for Railway Board Secretariat Service, the service whose officers handle the secretariat work of the Railway Board.

q: In Indian Railways, the designation 'CLI', borne by a senior supervisor who inspects and counsels loco running staff, stands for:
e: CLI stands for Chief Loco Inspector, the senior supervisor who rides with, inspects and counsels loco running staff.

q: In the family of public sector undertakings supplying rolling stock to the Railways, 'BEML' stands for:
e: BEML, the PSU making rail and metro products, stands for Bharat Earth Movers Limited, its original name on incorporation.

q: In Indian Railways, the designation 'GM', borne by the officer in overall charge of a zonal railway, stands for:
e: GM stands for General Manager, the officer in overall charge of a zonal railway.

q: In the engineering and technical departments of Indian Railways, the supervisory post 'JE' stands for:
e: JE stands for Junior Engineer, the entry supervisory post in the engineering and technical departments.

q: In the financial sector of India, the abbreviation 'SEBI' stands for:

options.B: Securities and Exchange Board of India
options.C: Securities and Equity Board of India
options.D: Stock and Exchange Board of India

e: SEBI regulates the securities markets, and its full form is Securities and Exchange Board of India.

q: In the tax administration of India, the abbreviation 'CBIC' stands for:

options.A: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs
options.B: Central Board of Indirect Taxation and Commerce
options.C: Central Bureau of Indirect Taxes and Customs
options.D: Central Board of Integrated Taxes and Customs

e: CBIC administers indirect taxes and customs, and it stands for Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs.

q: In India's digital governance, the mobile application platform 'UMANG' stands for:

options.A: Unified Mobile App for National Governance
options.B: Unified Mobile Application for New Governance
options.C: Unified Ministry Application for New-age Governance
options.D: Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance

e: UMANG gives mobile access to government services, and it stands for Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance.

q: In the grievance-redressal system of the Government of India, the portal denoted by 'CPGRAMS' stands for:

options.A: Central Public Grievance Redress and Management System
options.B: Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System
options.C: Central Public Grievance Resolution and Monitoring System
options.D: Centralised Public Grievance Reporting and Monitoring System

e: CPGRAMS is the government's grievance portal, and it stands for Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System.

q: With effect from November 2024, Indian Railways reduced the advance reservation period for reserved train tickets from 120 days to:
e: From November 2024 the advance reservation period was cut from 120 days to 60 days to reduce touting and improve planning.

q: With effect from which date was Aadhaar-based authentication made mandatory for booking Tatkal tickets through the IRCTC website and application?
e: Aadhaar-based authentication was made mandatory for online Tatkal booking on IRCTC with effect from 1 July 2025.

q: As per the Railway Board's decision of 2025, the first reservation chart of a long-distance train is now prepared how many hours before the scheduled departure of the train?
e: Under the Railway Board's 2025 decision, the first reservation chart is prepared 8 hours before departure, earlier than the previous practice.

q: In January 2022, Indian Railways renamed the post of the train 'Guard' as:
e: In January 2022 the post of Guard was renamed Train Manager to better reflect the duties of the train's rear-end in-charge.

q: The 'clone trains' introduced by Indian Railways in September 2020 were duplicate trains run primarily to:

options.A: Accommodate waitlisted passengers on high-demand routes
options.B: Carry parcel and freight traffic on passenger routes
options.C: Promote heritage tourism on hill sections
options.D: Carry railway staff to their places of posting

e: Clone trains were duplicate services run on high-demand routes in September 2020 mainly to clear waitlisted passengers.

q: During the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, Indian Railways converted a large number of its coaches into:
e: During COVID-19 in 2020, Railways converted coaches into isolation coaches with beds and medical facilities for COVID-19 patients.

q: The AC-3 Economy class of Indian Railways, offering air-conditioned travel at a fare lower than the regular AC-3 tier, was first introduced in the year:
e: AC-3 Economy, with improved berths at a fare below regular AC-3 tier, was first introduced in 2021.

q: The 'Hungry for Cargo' initiative launched by Indian Railways in 2021 was aimed primarily at:

options.A: Improving the punctuality of passenger trains
options.B: Attracting new traffic and increasing freight loading
options.C: Reducing the staff cost of the Railways
options.D: Completing the electrification of broad gauge routes

e: Hungry for Cargo, launched in 2021, was a freight marketing drive to attract new traffic and increase freight loading.

q: The Yog Nagari Rishikesh railway station, opened in January 2021, is the originating station of which new railway line under construction in Uttarakhand?
e: Yog Nagari Rishikesh station, opened in January 2021, is the originating station of the Rishikesh-Karnaprayag line in Uttarakhand.

q: The railway station in Maharashtra earlier known as Osmanabad has been renamed as:
e: Osmanabad station and district in Maharashtra were renamed Dharashiv, and the station carries the new name.

q: The Diesel Modernisation Works (DMW) at Patiala, now known as the Patiala Locomotive Works, was originally set up primarily for the:

options.B: Mid-life rehabilitation and modernisation of diesel locomotives
options.D: Production of railway wheels and axles

e: The Diesel Modernisation Works at Patiala was set up for mid-life rehabilitation and modernisation of diesel locomotives.

q: The Rail Wheel Factory at Bengaluru, the production unit manufacturing wheels and axles for Indian Railways, was inaugurated in the year:
e: The Rail Wheel Factory at Bengaluru, which makes wheels and axles, was inaugurated in 1984.

q: 'Project Swarn', launched by Indian Railways in 2017 to improve the quality of services and passenger experience, was initially implemented on which premium train services?

options.B: All superfast mail and express trains

e: Project Swarn, launched in 2017 to upgrade passenger experience, was first implemented on Rajdhani and Shatabdi Express trains.

q: The Golden Rock Railway Workshop at Tiruchirappalli manufactures the oil-fired steam locomotives of 'X' class for use on which mountain railway?
e: Golden Rock Workshop at Tiruchirappalli builds the X class oil-fired steam locomotives used on the Nilgiri Mountain Railway.

q: The Railway Protection Special Force (RPSF), a specialised wing of the Railway Protection Force, primarily serves as:

options.A: The investigating agency for crimes on passenger trains
options.B: The personal security unit of senior railway officers
options.C: The training establishment of the Railway Protection Force
options.D: A reserve striking force deployed to deal with law-and-order emergencies and disturbances affecting railway working

e: The RPSF is a reserve striking force of the RPF, deployed for law-and-order emergencies and disturbances affecting railway working.

q: The Jamalpur Workshop of Eastern Railway, one of the oldest workshops of Indian Railways, is traditionally renowned for the manufacture of which equipment?

options.B: The 'Jamalpur Jack', a heavy-duty lifting jack used in workshops and breakdown work

e: Jamalpur Workshop is renowned for the Jamalpur Jack, the heavy-duty lifting jack it devised for workshop and breakdown work.

q: The Bhilai Steel Plant of the Steel Authority of India Limited is the principal supplier of which key permanent-way material to Indian Railways?

options.C: Fish plates and elastic rail clips

e: Bhilai Steel Plant is Railways' principal supplier of rails, including long rail panels, for the permanent way.

q: The Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Limited (MRVC), which executes suburban railway projects in the Mumbai region, was incorporated in the year:
e: Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation, which executes Mumbai suburban rail projects, was incorporated in 1999.

q: The Indian Railways Station Development Corporation Limited (IRSDC), set up for the redevelopment of railway stations, was wound up in the year:
e: IRSDC, set up for station redevelopment, was wound up in 2021 and its station work was transferred to other railway agencies.

q: The Karnail Singh Stadium in New Delhi, which serves as the home ground of the Railways cricket team in domestic tournaments, is owned by:
e: Karnail Singh Stadium in New Delhi is owned by Indian Railways and is the home ground of the Railways cricket team.

q: Under the 'One Nation One Standard' initiative of the Bureau of Indian Standards, the first organisation in the country to be recognised as a Standards Development Organisation (SDO) was:
e: Under One Nation One Standard, RDSO was the first organisation recognised by BIS as a Standards Development Organisation.

q: In the Madhepura Electric Locomotive Private Limited (MELPL), the joint venture executing the electric locomotive factory at Madhepura, the majority shareholding of 76 per cent is held by:
e: In MELPL, the Madhepura locomotive joint venture, Alstom holds the majority 76 per cent shareholding, with Railways holding the rest.

q: The 'Mahaparinirvan Express', the special tourist train operated by IRCTC, covers the pilgrimage circuit associated with:
e: The Mahaparinirvan Express covers the Buddhist pilgrimage circuit linked with Lord Buddha and Dr. Ambedkar's association with it.

q: The National Federation of Indian Railwaymen (NFIR), one of the two recognised federations of railway employees, was founded in the year:
e: The National Federation of Indian Railwaymen, a recognised federation of railway employees, was founded in 1948.

q: The first railway line in Assam, opened in 1882 for serving the coal mines and tea gardens of Upper Assam, was the:
e: Assam's first railway, opened in 1882 for the coal mines and tea gardens of Upper Assam, was the Dibru-Sadiya Railway.

q: The first railway line in Kerala, opened in 1861, was built between:
e: Kerala's first railway line, opened in 1861, ran between Tirur and Beypore in the Malabar region.

q: New Delhi railway station, one of the busiest railway stations in India, has how many platforms?
e: New Delhi railway station has 16 platforms, handling its heavy Rajdhani, express and suburban traffic.

q: How many divisions are there under the South Central Railway, with headquarters at Secunderabad?
e: South Central Railway has six divisions: Secunderabad, Hyderabad, Vijayawada, Guntur, Guntakal and Nanded.

q: The Zonal Railway Training Institute at Bhuli in Jharkhand functions under which zonal railway?
e: Official training centre lists show the Zonal Railway Training Institute at Bhuli as an Eastern Railway institute.

q: The Zonal Railway Training Institute at Mancheswar in Bhubaneswar functions under which zonal railway?
e: The Zonal Railway Training Institute at Mancheswar in Bhubaneswar functions under East Coast Railway, headquartered in that city.

q: The Diesel Loco Shed at Barddhaman in West Bengal, which homes diesel locomotives, functions under which zonal railway?
e: Barddhaman, or Burdwan, is in Eastern Railway territory, so its Diesel Loco Shed functions under Eastern Railway.

q: Which zonal railway of Indian Railways is the largest in terms of route kilometres?
e: Northern Railway has the largest route kilometrage of any zone, covering the vast northern network from Delhi.

q: The Haldibari-Chilahati rail link, reopened for traffic in December 2020 after a gap of about five decades, reconnected India by rail with:
e: The Haldibari-Chilahati link, reopened in December 2020 after about five decades, reconnected India with Bangladesh by rail.

q: Barog, a station on the UNESCO-listed Kalka-Shimla Railway famous for one of the longest tunnels on the section, is located in the State of:
e: Barog is on the Kalka-Shimla line in Solan district of Himachal Pradesh, famous for its long tunnel.

q: In the organised Group 'A' services of Indian Railways, 'IRSSE' stands for:

options.A: Indian Railways Service of Stores Engineers
options.B: Indian Railways Safety and Security Establishment
options.D: Indian Railways Service of Signal Engineers

e: IRSSE stands for Indian Railways Service of Signal Engineers, the Group A service for signal engineering officers.

q: At a zonal railway headquarters, the designation 'CRSE', borne by a senior officer of the mechanical department looking after rolling stock, stands for:
e: CRSE stands for Chief Rolling Stock Engineer, the mechanical officer at zonal headquarters looking after rolling stock.

q: In the engineering department of Indian Railways, the designation 'CBE', borne by the officer in charge of bridges at a zonal headquarters, stands for:
e: CBE stands for Chief Bridge Engineer, the officer in charge of bridges at a zonal headquarters.

q: In the construction organisations of Indian Railways, the designation 'AXEN', borne by an officer of the engineering department, stands for:
e: AXEN stands for Assistant Executive Engineer, a gazetted engineering post in construction and open line organisations.

q: In the running staff of Indian Railways, the designation 'ALP', borne by the assistant to the loco pilot in the locomotive cab, stands for:
e: ALP stands for Assistant Loco Pilot, who assists the loco pilot in the cab and watches signals and procedures.

q: In the refund of e-tickets on Indian Railways, the document denoted by 'TDR', filed by the passenger for claiming refund in specified circumstances, stands for:
e: TDR stands for Ticket Deposit Receipt, filed by an e-ticket passenger to claim refund in specified circumstances.

q: In the stores organisation of Indian Railways, the designation 'DMS', borne by the officer in charge of a stores depot, stands for:
e: DMS stands for Depot Material Superintendent, the officer in charge of a stores depot in the stores organisation.

q: In the engineering department of Indian Railways, the manual denoted by 'IRPWM', which lays down the standards for track maintenance, stands for:

options.C: Indian Railways Procurement and Works Manual
options.D: Integrated Rail Planning and Works Manual

e: IRPWM stands for Indian Railways Permanent Way Manual, which lays down standards for track maintenance.

q: In the signal and telecommunication department of Indian Railways, the manual denoted by 'IRSEM' stands for:
e: IRSEM stands for Indian Railways Signal Engineering Manual, the manual for signal engineering practice.

q: At a zonal railway headquarters, the designation 'CPRO', borne by the officer who deals with the media and public relations, stands for:
e: CPRO stands for Chief Public Relations Officer, the zonal officer dealing with media and public relations.

q: In the engineering department of a zonal railway, the designation 'CTE', borne by the officer in charge of track matters at the headquarters, stands for:
e: CTE stands for Chief Track Engineer, the officer in charge of track matters at a zonal headquarters.

q: The priority corridor of the Agra Metro, inaugurated in March 2024, connects Taj East Gate with which station?
e: The Agra Metro priority corridor inaugurated in March 2024 runs from Taj East Gate to Mankameshwar station.

q: India's first Vande Bharat Sleeper Express, flagged off in January 2026, has been introduced on the route between:
e: India's first Vande Bharat Sleeper Express, flagged off in January 2026, was introduced between Howrah and Kamakhya.

q: One of the first two Amrit Bharat Express trains flagged off in December 2023 connects Malda Town in West Bengal with which station?
e: One of the first two Amrit Bharat Express trains of December 2023 ran from Malda Town to SMVT Bengaluru.

q: India's first 'Water Metro' service, a network of electric-hybrid ferry boats integrated with the metro system, was launched in April 2023 in the city of:
e: India's first Water Metro, with electric-hybrid ferry boats integrated with the metro, was launched in Kochi in April 2023.

q: The first Rajdhani Express of Indian Railways to be provided with modern Tejas sleeper coaches, in February 2021, was the:
e: The Mumbai Central-New Delhi Rajdhani Express was the first Rajdhani provided with modern Tejas sleeper coaches, in February 2021.

q: India's first air-conditioned suburban local train service was introduced in December 2017 on the suburban railway network of:
e: India's first air-conditioned suburban local train was introduced in December 2017 on the Mumbai suburban network.

q: The first Vande Bharat Express service of Madhya Pradesh, flagged off in April 2023, connects Rani Kamalapati station at Bhopal with:
e: Madhya Pradesh's first Vande Bharat, flagged off in April 2023, runs from Rani Kamalapati at Bhopal to Hazrat Nizamuddin, Delhi.

q: The first metro rail service of Bihar, whose priority corridor was inaugurated in October 2025, has been started in the city of:
e: Bihar's first metro service, with its priority corridor inaugurated in October 2025, was started in Patna.

q: The Wardha Road corridor of the Nagpur Metro is nationally noted for having:

options.C: India's longest double-decker viaduct, carrying the metro line above a road flyover
options.D: India's first metro line built across a river

e: Nagpur Metro's Wardha Road corridor is noted for India's longest double-decker viaduct, carrying the metro above a road flyover.

q: The metro rail system of Bhopal in Madhya Pradesh is popularly known by the name:
e: Bhopal's metro rail system is popularly named Bhoj Metro, after Raja Bhoj, the historic ruler associated with the city.

q: BEML Limited, the public sector undertaking which manufactures metro coaches, rail coaches and other railway products, functions under the administrative control of the:
e: BEML Limited functions under the administrative control of the Ministry of Defence, though it also makes rail and metro products.

q: In the restructuring of the Railway Board carried out in 2020, the post of Financial Commissioner (Railways) was abolished and its functions were entrusted to the newly created post of:
e: In the 2020 Railway Board restructuring, the Financial Commissioner's post was abolished and its functions given to the new Member (Finance).

q: Who became the first woman to head the Railway Board on taking over as its Chairperson in September 2023?
e: Jaya Varma Sinha became the first woman to head the Railway Board, taking over as Chairperson in September 2023.

q: The Research Designs and Standards Organisation (RDSO) at Lucknow, the research and standards organisation of Indian Railways, is headed by an officer designated as the:
e: RDSO at Lucknow is headed by a Director General, the standard designation for its chief executive officer.

q: The headquarters of the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway, the UNESCO-listed narrow gauge mountain railway, is located at:
e: The headquarters of the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway is at Kurseong, midway on the hill line below Darjeeling.

q: The Central Hospital at Hubballi, the headquarters hospital of its zone, belongs to which zonal railway?
e: Hubballi is the headquarters of South Western Railway, so its Central Hospital belongs to that zone.

q: The Central Hospital at Prayagraj is the headquarters (central) hospital of which zonal railway?
e: Prayagraj is the headquarters of North Central Railway, so its Central Hospital is that zone's headquarters hospital.

q: 'Rail Vihar' at Chandrasekharpur in Bhubaneswar is the headquarters building of which zonal railway?
e: Rail Vihar at Chandrasekharpur in Bhubaneswar is the headquarters building of East Coast Railway.

q: The first steam locomotive rolled out by the Chittaranjan Locomotive Works in 1950 was named:
e: The first steam locomotive rolled out by Chittaranjan Locomotive Works in 1950 was named Deshbandhu.

q: The Mahalaxmi Workshop of Western Railway at Mumbai mainly undertakes the periodic overhaul of:
e: The Mahalaxmi Workshop of Western Railway at Mumbai mainly undertakes periodic overhaul of suburban EMU rakes.

q: The Kanchrapara Workshop of Eastern Railway in West Bengal mainly undertakes the periodic overhaul of:
e: The Kanchrapara Workshop of Eastern Railway mainly undertakes periodic overhaul of EMU and MEMU rakes.

q: How many railway divisions are there under the Northeast Frontier Railway, with headquarters at Maligaon?
e: Northeast Frontier Railway has five divisions: Katihar, Alipurduar, Rangiya, Lumding and Tinsukia.

q: How many railway divisions are there under the North Central Railway, with headquarters at Prayagraj?
e: North Central Railway has three divisions: Prayagraj, Agra and Jhansi.

q: The Supervisors Training Centre (STC) at Jhansi functions under which zonal railway?
e: Jhansi is in North Central Railway, so the Supervisors Training Centre there functions under that zone.

q: The Southern Railway, the first zonal railway to be created after Independence, came into existence in the year:
e: Southern Railway, the first zone created after Independence, came into existence on 14 April 1951.

q: The North Eastern Railway, formed by amalgamating the Oudh and Tirhut Railway and the Assam Railway, came into existence in the year:
e: North Eastern Railway was formed in 1952 by amalgamating the Oudh and Tirhut Railway and the Assam Railway.

q: The East Coast Railway, with headquarters at Bhubaneswar, became operational as a separate zonal railway in the year:
e: East Coast Railway, headquartered at Bhubaneswar, became operational as a separate zone in 2003.

q: The heritage steam locomotive shed at Rewari in Haryana, which preserves and maintains vintage steam locomotives, functions under which zonal railway?
e: The heritage steam locomotive shed at Rewari in Haryana functions under Northern Railway.

q: The Rail Museum at Mysuru, among the earliest railway museums in the country, was set up in the year:
e: The Rail Museum at Mysuru, among India's earliest railway museums, was set up in 1979.

q: In Indian Railways, the abbreviation 'ART', denoting the relief train rushed to the site of an accident, stands for:
e: ART stands for Accident Relief Train, the train rushed to an accident site with cranes, tools and relief staff.

q: In the engineering department of Indian Railways, the designation 'XEN', borne by an officer senior to the Assistant Executive Engineer, stands for:
e: XEN stands for Executive Engineer, the engineering officer senior to the Assistant Executive Engineer.

q: In the engineering department of Indian Railways, the designation 'ADEN', borne by the officer in charge of a section of a division, stands for:
e: ADEN stands for Assistant Divisional Engineer, the officer in charge of a section of a division.

q: At a zonal railway headquarters, the designation 'CFTM', borne by a senior officer of the operating department looking after freight traffic, stands for:
e: CFTM stands for Chief Freight Transportation Manager, the operating officer at headquarters looking after freight traffic.

q: In the metro rail sector, 'MEGA', the original name of the company which implemented the Ahmedabad-Gandhinagar metro project, stood for:

options.A: Metro-Link Express for Gandhinagar and Ahmedabad
options.B: Metro Express for Gujarat and Ahmedabad

e: MEGA stood for Metro-Link Express for Gandhinagar and Ahmedabad, the company that implemented that metro project.

q: The name 'DISHA' of the artificial intelligence-based chatbot 'AskDISHA' of the Indian Railways Catering and Tourism Corporation stands for:

options.A: Automated System for Help and Digital Information on Services
options.B: Digital Interaction to Seek Help Anytime
options.C: Digital India Service for Help and Assistance
options.D: Direct Interaction for Seeking Help Anytime

e: DISHA in AskDISHA stands for Digital Interaction to Seek Help Anytime, IRCTC's AI-based customer support chatbot.

q: In the conduct of elections in India, the abbreviation 'VVPAT', denoting the printer unit attached to the electronic voting machine, stands for:

options.B: Voter Verifiable Printing and Audit Terminal

e: VVPAT stands for Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail, the printer unit attached to the electronic voting machine.

q: Under the Unified Pension Scheme (UPS), which came into effect on 1 April 2025 for Central Government employees including railway employees, the assured payout after a minimum of 25 years of qualifying service is equal to what percentage of the average basic pay drawn during the last 12 months of service?
e: Under the Unified Pension Scheme, 25 years of qualifying service assures a payout of 50 per cent of average basic pay of the last 12 months.

q: The 'StartUps for Railways' policy, launched by Indian Railways in June 2022, primarily aims to:

options.A: Leverage innovative technologies and solutions developed by Indian startups, MSMEs and innovators for railway working
options.B: Set up new railway universities in partnership with private institutions
options.C: Hand over the operation of passenger trains to private companies
options.D: Recruit engineering graduates directly as railway officers

e: StartUps for Railways, launched in June 2022, aims to use innovations from Indian startups, MSMEs and innovators in railway working.

q: The cross-border passenger train service between Jaynagar in India and Kurtha in Nepal was inaugurated in the year:
e: The Jaynagar-Kurtha cross-border passenger train between India and Nepal was inaugurated in 2022.

q: Pasighat town, which received its first railway connectivity in 2025 with the commissioning of the new Murkongselek-Pasighat line, is located in the State of:
e: Pasighat, connected by the Murkongselek-Pasighat line in 2025, is a town in Arunachal Pradesh.
